_why: Which component states are actually DRAWN in the Figma file, measured by reading every component set's layer and text names rather than asserted from memory. vds-bridge.js reads this to fill `states.drawn` in each register record. A snapshot, not a live query: scaffolding must work offline, and a bridge that silently claimed a state was drawn because it could not reach Figma would be the worst of both.
_howToRefresh: Re-read the 24 component sets in file 4pPUFvaPdqYzPquBusSfWl, look for the evidence layer named below, and update. tests/spec.test.js pins that every block naming a state here is one whose code conditionally renders it.
_vocabulary: VDS state names, not CSS class names. VDS accepts default|hover|focus|active|selected|disabled|loading|error|success and REFUSES a record naming anything else.
_evidence: Each value names a LAYER in the component set, and every one starts state: or spec: so it can be looked up. A sentence is a description, not a citation: the formfield error was cited as "That reference does not exist." because Figma names a text layer after its content, and that drifts the moment the copy is edited. Verified present by re-reading the file after naming.
